english.meaning: by all means; used before a negative to give a strong warning not to do something
english.note: Used before 唔好, as in 千其唔好.

exampleSentences.english: Sprained my ankle. Whatever you do, don’t let him sprain his—we’d be screwed.
exampleSentences.traditional: 拗咗柴。千其唔好俾佢拗柴，拗柴𠻺死火嘞。
